_comment: SAI Khelo India — daily expenditure automation. Edit paths and the division mapping here; no code changes needed.

googleSheets._note: Pulls SAI Expenditure SYNC live before every run, no credentials needed — the sheet is shared 'anyone with the link can view', which is enough to fetch its Excel export directly. When enabled, this REPLACES paths.testSheet2 with a freshly-downloaded copy on every run; if the fetch fails (no internet, sheet unshared), the last successfully cached copy is used instead and a warning is added, so a network hiccup never stops a run outright. Set enabled to false to go back to only reading the manually-placed file at paths.testSheet2.

testSheet2.rcColumnAliasesNote: The live sheet's own per-RC column header for Lucknow is misspelled 'LUCNOW' (missing the K) — normalised-string matching can't catch a dropped letter, so it needs an explicit correction here.

_divisionsNote: The KI-1 / KI-2 split and componentTargets below were taken from the 'Components of KI 1 / KI 2' panels in the 02.09.2026 Expenditure Summary Report PDF, then verified against live data: this split reproduces the Assignment tab's own expenditure figures exactly (KI-1 48.3636 Cr, KI-2 97.4687 Cr), and each division's targets sum exactly to its assignment. The live cross-check in src/pipeline.js re-verifies this on every run.
_assignedNote: Each division's 'assigned' below is now only a FALLBACK. A division is assigned the sum of its own componentTargets, and the KI Infra division the States/UTs table's total read live from the sheet (rollup.cjs, VENDOR PATCH 9) — so the division table always adds up to its own component rows, and matches the platform's KI 1 / KI 2 / INFRA panel, which derives its figures the same way. The workbook's Assignment tab is still read and still overwrites these numbers, but with every component targeted that override no longer decides anything; its expenditure column still runs the live cross-check. The figures here are kept in step anyway, for the case where componentTargets is empty: they include the 25.09.2026 allocation (KI-2 +67.98 Cr, SAI-INFRA +50.00 Cr) and KI Infra at 57.36 Cr.
_componentLabelsNote: Maps the long Sheet3 component names to the short labels used in the Word file.
_componentTargetsNote: Per-component assignment/target figures in rupees, sourced from the PDF report's component panels. These are NOT in any Google Sheet tab (checked) — they are maintained in the dashboard app. Edit them on the Divisions page or here; each division's targets should sum to its assignment.
_agencyAliasNote: Maps the Child Agency Name as written in the RBI report to the Test sheet 2 tab name. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores the SAI/RC/NSNIS prefixes, so most names resolve without an entry here.

output._note: Only the 'report' layout is produced — it reproduces the Expenditure Summary Report PDF. The older 'division' and 'balance' layouts still exist in src/docgen.js and can be re-added here if ever wanted.

weeklyLeaderboard._note: Extra page: last week (Mon-Sun) Regional Centre spend from DSC_Details. DDO desks are always excluded. Set onlyOnMonday false to put it on every report.

manualOverrides._note: Hand-entered figures for the page-1 summary table, in RUPEES. Any value set here is used on every report until cleared; the dashboard flags on its status card whenever any are in force. null = compute from the sheet.
manualOverrides._totalAssignedNote: Left to compute, deliberately. It is now the sum of the four divisions, and each of those is the sum of its own components (or, for KI Infra, of the States/UTs table) — so the total follows an allocation the moment componentTargets carries it, with nothing to re-type and nothing to go stale. It computes to 516,55,00,000 today: 100.86 + 228.78 + 129.55 + 57.36 Cr. It was fixed at that same figure, and at 394,01,00,000 before the 25.09.2026 allocation. The workbook's Assignment tab states 516,54,75,000, which is 25,000 lower for a reason already known: its own total has carried that shortfall since the desktop tool. Typing a figure into the dashboard and ticking Fixed still overrides all of this, for the day someone needs it to.

expenditureBaseline._note: Known-good cumulative expenditure as at asOn, in RUPEES. When only yesterday-s figure is entered, Total Expenditure is derived as baseline + that figure.

_allocationsNote: Allocations already folded into the figures above, by date. Because a database that already holds a config ignores this file, each allocation is ALSO applied to the stored copy once, by applyAllocations() in store.ts, which reads this same list to know what it has done. Never remove an entry to force a re-run: that would add the money a second time.
_seedNote: Seed copy of the automation config, used the first time the platform boots with an empty report_state. After that the live copy is the one in Postgres (report_state.key=config), which is what the manual-figures endpoint writes to. Editing this file changes nothing on a database that already has a row — which is why an allocation needs the one-time migration named above, not just an edit here. The upstream 'automation' block is deliberately absent: it configured the desktop tool's morning cron, and on the platform a report is produced only when somebody presses Process now.
